mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% per year) indicates a 'stagflation' risk, where monetary policy is too loose for inflation but not enough to stimulate growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime, characterized by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% per year, restrictive policy increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between strong housing demand (HOUST > 600) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicates a supportive environment for consumer spending and low-cost financing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 3.0%) and elevated industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0), the economy approaches overheating, leading to increased risk of policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
